cases.title: Grade appeal, CS 210 Data Structures

agent.name: Grade Review Assistant
agent.purpose: Applies course rubrics to disputed items and drafts a regrade recommendation.

decision.summary: Rubric criterion was scored twice on Problem 4. Corrected score 94/100, up from 88/100.
decision.recommendation: Uphold the appeal and post the corrected grade.
decision.outcome: Regrade approved. Instructor countersigned and the registrar updated the transcript.

cases.artifact: Decision record AP-2291, term 2026-AUT. Course CS 210 Data Structures. The Grade Review Assistant recomputed Problem 4 against rubric v4.2 and found that the recursion-depth criterion had been scored twice in the first pass. Corrected score: 94/100, up from 88/100. This finding is advisory. The course instructor retains final authority over grade changes and countersigned the corrected score before posting. Confidence 0.91 with exponential decay and a 60-day half-life. Sources: CS 210 rubric v4.2, Grade Appeal Policy 4.1, and NIST AI RMF MEASURE 2.8. The submission hash and rubric anchor were checked, and the registrar ledger was verified before this record was sealed.

confidence.rationale: Calibrated against the last 90 days of review outcomes for this agent.

cases.title: Integrity screening, ENG 204 Academic Writing

agent.name: Integrity Screening Assistant
agent.purpose: Estimates the likelihood that submitted prose was drafted with generative assistance.

decision.summary: Detector reported 0.63 likelihood of generative drafting. Committee found insufficient evidence of misconduct.
decision.recommendation: Close the case with no disciplinary finding.
decision.outcome: No violation recorded. Learning note issued on citation practice. Student notified in writing.

cases.artifact: Decision record AI-4471, term 2026-AUT. Course ENG 204 Academic Writing. The Integrity Screening Assistant v2.3 reported a 0.63 likelihood that the submitted essay was drafted with generative assistance. The committee checked the detector output, the document revision history, and two oral defense responses. A likelihood estimate is not a finding of misconduct. The committee found insufficient evidence for a violation. Outcome: no disciplinary finding, and a learning note on citation practice is issued. This record is advisory to the Dean of Students and is disclosed to the student. Confidence 0.58 with a 30-day half-life. Sources: Academic Integrity Policy 6.3, the detector model card, and the submission hash.

cases.title: Accommodation triage, STAT 150

agent.name: Access Triage Assistant
agent.purpose: Reads accommodation documentation and drafts an eligibility recommendation.

decision.summary: Triage recommended denial. Board overturned and approved 25 percent extended time plus live captioning.
decision.outcome: Accommodation active for the remainder of the term. Decision disclosed to the student with the clinical basis redacted.

cases.artifact: Decision record AC-1180, term 2026-AUT. Course STAT 150. The Access Triage Assistant recommended denying a 25 percent extended-time accommodation because the submitted documentation did not match its eligibility template. The Accessibility Office reviewed the clinical letter, the prior accommodation history, and Section 504 guidance. The template mismatch was caused by an outdated form, not by a missing diagnosis. The Board overturned the recommendation and approved 25 percent extended time plus live captioning. This record is disclosed to the student and retained with the accommodation file. Confidence 0.71 with a 45-day half-life. Sources: Accommodations Policy 2.4, Section 504 guidance, and the clinical letter hash.

confidence.rationale: Calibrated against the last 90 days of review outcomes for this agent.

cases.title: AI tutor feedback release, BIO 110

agent.name: Tutor Coach
agent.purpose: Generates formative feedback on weekly problem sets.

decision.summary: Formative feedback drafted for 312 students. Release held pending Oversight Board quorum.
decision.recommendation: Release after review with an AI-assisted disclosure banner.
decision.outcome: Awaiting a fourth attestation. 14 responses were removed before release.

cases.artifact: Decision record FB-0925, term 2026-AUT. Course BIO 110. The Tutor Coach generated formative feedback for 312 students and proposed releasing it without review. The teaching team checked the feedback against the unit rubric, removed 14 responses that cited a source that could not be verified, and added a disclosure banner stating that the feedback was AI-assisted and advisory. Release is pending Oversight Board quorum. Confidence 0.84 with a 30-day half-life. Sources: BIO 110 unit rubric, the feedback review log, and the provider model card.
